openAsApp: Open Murmur as an app (npm run tauri dev) to record.
englishModelMissing: To record in English, download the English model.
deleteMessageWithAudio: The transcript, notes and saved audio of “{{title}}” will be deleted. This can't be undone.
deleteMessage: The transcript and notes of “{{title}}” will be deleted. This can't be undone.
coverNeedsModel: Turn on the cover in Settings › Intelligence and download the model.
coverAfterRecording: It can be generated once the recording ends.
missingModelBody: Murmur transcribes with a model that runs on this Mac. You only need to download it once.
emptyBody: Record a meeting and the transcript will appear live, split by speaker. Everything is processed on this Mac: local means private.
consentReminder: Remember to ask participants for their consent.
exportScreensTitle: Choose where to save the screenshots
